title: The stairs
goals: Do it in fewer than 5 lines.
starting_code:
# This program reaches the landing but bumps twice. Make it better!
wizard.move_up(3)
wizard.move_right(3)
wizard.move_up(3)
wizard.move_right(2)
hints: Watch your wizard walk. Your wizard bumps into the wall when moving up.
The numbers in both `move_up` actions are too big.
Change the number in both `move_up` actions to a 2.
intro: My program climbs the stone steps to the landing. It bumps into the wall twice because two numbers are too big. You can make it better!
outro: Perfect! We are back at the gate, without any bumps.
learned: Now you know more about how much, which programmers call arguments.
